entities.name: Kenzō Tsujimoto
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kenzo Tsujimoto  is a Japanese businessman who founded the video game companies Capcom and Irem. He has also served as president of the Computer Software Copyright Association since 1997, and was president of Computer Entertainment Supplier's Association from 2002 to 2006.
